Namespace Gadema.Core.Models.Game.EngineIntegration

Classes

EngineExportConfig

Defines the configuration settings for exporting project content to external game engines. This entity stores the target engine type, export format, and activation status.

EngineFieldMapping

Maps internal content fields to their corresponding property names in a game engine. This facilitates the automated export of narrative data (e.g., Character Names, Item Stats) into engines like Unity or Unreal.

GameKeyEvent

Represents a game-related event triggered by a specific narrative segment. This allows writers to embed interactive mechanics (like giving items or setting flags) directly into the story flow via scene segments.
